Yarn's Plug'n'Play install mode skips node_modules entirely — a single .pnp.cjs file resolves every module at runtime.
A cold install on a 400-package monorepo drops from 48.4s with npm to 14.2s with Yarn 4 — thanks to parallel fetch and content-addressable caching.
The yarn.lock format is deterministic and diff-friendly: reordering never changes the file, and conflicts are resolvable by hand.
yarn workspaces foreach runs scripts across every package in topological order — no extra tooling, no Lerna, no glue.
Zero-install repos commit the offline mirror so git clone is enough to start coding — no install step, no CI warm-up.
Every release since 2.0 has been a native ESM binary distributed via corepack — no global install, version pinned per-project.
